info.title: reluai.cloud API
info.description:
Backend for [reluai.cloud](https://reluai.cloud) — portfolio demonstrations running on a
2-vCPU / 8 GB VPS. All demos work without paid APIs.

post.description: Send a message. Limited to 3 per hour and 6 per day per visitor.

get.description: Dashboard tiles: last run, last success, totals, recent trend and queue state.
Measured results per drop (latest successful run of each), for the project page.

schema.title: Response Get Runs Api Pipeline Runs Get

post.description: Queue a pipeline run. Limited per visitor and by overall queue capacity.

schema.title: Response Get Scenarios Api Pipeline Scenarios Get
Response Get Drops Api Pipeline Drops Get

get.description: Every reason code the validator can assign, with its explanation.

schema.title: Response Get Reasons Api Pipeline Reasons Get

get.description: The bundled real retailer table: columns, profile and data-quality findings.

post.description: Profile an uploaded CSV. It is stored for one hour and its contents are never logged.
Interpret a question (rules first, then an optional LLM tool call) and answer it.

get.description: The latest run of the fixed question sets (development and held-out).
How visitors' questions were handled over the last 30 days (no question text kept).
Scenarios, sample customers and the desk's settings.
The customer service policy the agent searches (written for this demo).

schema.title: Response Get Policy Api Support Policy Get

post.description: Start a conversation from a scenario or a customer and message; runs the first turn.
The supervisor's decision on a pending refund (the visitor plays the supervisor).

get.description: The latest scenario-suite run for each provider label (empty until one has run).

schema.title: Response Get Evaluation Api Support Evaluation Get

get.description: The bundled sample document (NIST AI RMF 1.0), ready for questions.

post.description:
Queue a PDF for reading. Poll ``GET /{id}`` until ``status`` is ready or failed.

The file is held in memory until the worker reads it, then discarded; the extracted text
is deleted after an hour. Neither is logged.

get.description: The latest evaluation run per answering method, on the sample document.

schema.title: Response Get Evaluation Api Documents Evaluation Get

get.description: Processing status, page counts, outline and warnings.

delete.description: Delete an uploaded document and its passages now, rather than after an hour.

get.description: The passages the document was split into, as they are searched.

post.description: Answer a question from this document only, citing page-numbered passages.

fallback_reason.title: Fallback Reason
fallback_reason.description: Why a model did not write this answer

word_overlap.title: Word Overlap
word_overlap.description: Extractive: weighted share of the question's words in the best sentence

similarity.title: Similarity
similarity.description: Extractive: cosine similarity of the best sentence to the question

allow_llm.title: Allow Llm
allow_llm.description: Uploads only: allow sending the column names and types (never the rows) to an LLM provider if the rules cannot interpret the question.

file.title: File
file.description: CSV file, up to 2 MB and 50,000 rows

llm_available.title: Llm Available
llm_available.description: Whether a language model is configured to read questions the rules cannot

pages_text.title: Pages Text
pages_text.description: Pages read from the PDF's text layer

ocr_skipped.title: Ocr Skipped
ocr_skipped.description: Scanned pages beyond the OCR limit (not read)

llm_available.title: Llm Available
llm_available.description: A model can write answers (otherwise extractive)

external_llm_available.title: External Llm Available
external_llm_available.description: A hosted model (Groq) is configured; uploads need the visitor's consent

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.description: Correct plans among questions the rules should answer

value.title: Value
value.description: Comparison value. A list for 'in'/'not_in', [low, high] for 'between' (dates as 'YYYY-MM-DD'), omitted for 'is_null'/'not_null'.

column.title: Column
column.description: Column to aggregate. Omit only for agg='count' (count of rows).

retrieved.title: Retrieved
retrieved.description: An expected page was among the retrieved passages

cited_expected.title: Cited Expected
cited_expected.description: The answer cited a passage on an expected page

time_bucket.description: Group a date column by day/week/month/quarter/year

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: metric_* orders by the first metric; group_* by the groups/time

QueryPlan.title: QueryPlan
QueryPlan.description: Aggregate query over one table: metrics, optionally grouped and filtered.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: auto: a model if one may be used, else extractive

allow_external.title: Allow External
allow_external.description: For uploads: allow sending the retrieved passages to the hosted model

label.title: Label
label.description: Heading for the column, e.g. 'Total revenue'

ResultsOut.title: ResultsOut
ResultsOut.description: Measured results: the latest successful run of every loaded drop.

dq_formula.title: Dq Formula
dq_formula.default: 100 × Σ(weight × passed) / Σ(weight); weights: gate 3, warn 2, info 1

needs_supervisor.title: Needs Supervisor
needs_supervisor.description: Whether the scenario involves a supervisor decision

UsageOut.title: UsageOut
UsageOut.description: Last 30 days of visitor questions, from the outcome log.
